messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: The customer cannot attend the scheduled demo because they have a claims audit that day and there are issues with how claims are logged.
  quote: Can we push the demo to next Tuesday? I’ve got a claims audit that day and can’t reschedule... let’s start with how claims get logged.
- problem: The platform does not allow pulling full audit logs for admin review, jeopardizing compliance deadlines.
  quote: we can pull full audit logs for admin review — it’s becoming urgent for our compliance team. We really need the audit-log export for admins to meet our internal compliance deadlines — it’s not just a nice-to-have anymore.
